summary: SoundHound AI, Inc. filed an 8-K on September 4, 2026, to disclose that it had filed a prospectus supplement for the resale of up to 36,894,839 shares of Class A common stock issued to former noteholders of LivePerson, Inc. in connection with its previously completed acquisition of LivePerson. The supplement satisfies contractual rights under a registration rights agreement. A legal opinion from Latham & Watkins LLP was filed as an exhibit. This is a routine registration-related current report and does not itself constitute an extraordinary corporate transaction.
